text: Chant the Shani mantra (Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah) on Saturdays
Recite Hanuman Chalisa, traditionally linked to pacifying Saturn
Feeding the poor is one of the best remedies for Saturn; donate food on your birthday and wedding anniversaries
Serve the needy, the elderly, the disabled and laborers - Saturn rewards selfless service (seva)
Donate black items for Saturn: black sesame, urad dal, black cloth, iron, mustard oil

text: Pour mustard oil on the ground or donate it - a classic Lal Kitab remedy for Saturn
Light a sesame-oil lamp under a Peepal tree on Saturday evenings
Avoid non-vegetarian food and alcohol on Saturdays
Do not keep alcohol openly at home - a Lal Kitab precaution for Saturn
Avoid extravagant birthday celebrations with drums - a Lal Kitab precaution for Saturn
Consistent effort, honesty and humility matter more than gemstones for Saturn - common advice on r/vedicastrology

text: Blue sapphire (neelam) is Saturn's stone but is widely advised against wearing without careful testing - it can backfire
Perform yagnas or homas dedicated to Saturn for severe affliction
Fast on Thursdays and wear yellow clothing to strengthen Jupiter
Chant the Guru Beej Mantra: Om Gram Greem Saha Gurve Namaha
Wear yellow sapphire or gold for Jupiter, only after consulting an astrologer
Donate yellow items on Thursdays: turmeric, saffron, sweets, chana dal, yellow flowers, yellow cloth, books
Apply turmeric or sandalwood tilak on the forehead - a Lal Kitab remedy for Jupiter
Donate bananas and sweets to elders; plant a peepal tree - Lal Kitab remedies for Jupiter
Jupiter can still give good results if Rahu, Saturn, Mercury or the Sun are strong in the chart
Fast on Wednesdays for Mercury; some traditions suggest avoiding salt during the fast
Chant the Budh Beej Mantra or the Gayatri Mantra for 45 days; worship Saraswati for Mercury
Wear an Emerald (Panna) for Mercury - only after proper consultation
Donate green items on Wednesdays for Mercury: moong dal, green vegetables, green cloth
Feed soaked green gram to birds as a Mercury remedy
Keep the teeth clean with alum, maintain cleanliness, avoid dishonesty - Lal Kitab remedies for Mercury
A weak Mercury can cause job losses and poor decision-making; remedies include emerald and donating green items on Wednesdays
Chant Om Suryaya Namaha or the Aditya Hridaya Stotra for the Sun
Offer water to the rising Sun (Surya arghya)
Donate wheat, jaggery, copper and red cloth on Sundays for the Sun
Wear Ruby (Manikya) set in gold on the ring finger for the Sun
For a weak Sun: respect the father, father figures and elders; feed cows
For a weak Sun, donate food, sweets, jaggery and clothes to the elderly, and wake up early
For a weak Moon: chant Om Chandraya Namaha 108 times, keep gentle bedtime routines, avoid screens before sleep
Donate rice, milk and white items at temples for the Moon
Wear a Pearl (Moti) for the Moon; drink from a silver glass
Seek the mother's blessings and avoid alcohol and meat to strengthen the Moon
Embrace moonlight and chant the Chandra mantra to please the Moon
Chant the Mangal Beej mantra (Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namaha) 11,000 times over 20 days with a Rudraksha rosary
Donate red lentils (masoor dal), red cloth and copper for Mars
Wear Red Coral (Moonga) for Mars
Perform Mangal Puja; control anger and exercise discipline as Mars remedies
Chant Om Shum Shukraya Namaha or Om Dram Dreem Droum Sah Shukraya Namaha 108 times daily for Venus
Donate white items on Fridays for Venus: rice, sugar, silver, white cloth
Wear a Diamond, or its substitutes Opal / White Sapphire, for Venus
For Venus: respect women, maintain cleanliness and hygiene, honour the luxury arts
Chant Om Raam Rahave Namaha 108 times for Rahu
Donate black sesame seeds, black cloth, mustard oil or blankets on Saturdays for Rahu
Wear Hessonite (Gomed) for Rahu
Keep an elephant idol at home and avoid speculation - Rahu remedies from a Lal Kitab list
Do the upaya (remedy) of the planet whose house Rahu occupies - a practitioner technique for Rahu
Chant Om Kem Ketave Namaha for Ketu
Donate blankets and sesame items to the needy for Ketu
Wear Cat's Eye (Lehsunia) for Ketu
Worship Lord Ganesha with durva grass, modak and coconut as a Ketu remedy
Gemstones are typically recommended only when the planet is benefic-but-weak; for malefic planets, mantra and charity (daan) are the preferred remedies
Gemstones are often recommended when slower-moving planets are weak in transit, especially if the person is running that planet's dasha during an important life phase
Behavioural remedies - discipline, service and honesty - are preferred over expensive rituals for weak planets
Always consult a qualified astrologer before wearing gemstones
Daan (donation) is the best way to reduce the malefic effects of a planet and it gives you a chance to do good deeds
